'''April 2001 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY in April 2001. [[Reid Smith]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2123">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-the-who-cares-reportd2123/ the-who-cares-report], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-the-who-cares-reportd2123/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Reid Smith]]
